quotes.text: The vendor record is the supplier folder. The invoice is the bill, matching is the proof check, workflow is the approval route, and settlement is the paid stamp.

takeaways: Vendor records, vendor groups and posting profiles set the payment terms, methods and ledger rules before the first invoice arrives.
Workflow approvals and two- or three-way matching with tolerances let clean invoices flow while exceptions get human review.
Payment proposals, payment journals and settlement link each payment to the invoices it clears, giving a traceable record of why money left the company.
hook: A supplier invoice arrives and the payment clock starts ticking, but what has to happen before money leaves the company? This episode explains Dynamics 365 Accounts Payable in plain English for finance staff and Dynamics newcomers. You will follow one bill from the vendor record through approval, matching, payment and settlement.
